description: Reports which hunt fields are still missing. When city, stay length, and budget are present, searches inventory. Does not save an alert or collect an email.

area_min.description: Optional minimum apartment size. Pair with area_unit. Omit for any size.

area_unit.description: Unit for area_min. Use sqft in Pune and sqm in other cities. Defaults from the city when area_min is set and this is omitted.

attached_bath.description: True only when an attached bath is required. Omit or false means not required, not excluded.

currency.description: Budget currency for price_max. Defaults to the city's local currency. USD rates are the live cached interbank quote. Saved alerts store the USD equivalent.

deposit_months_max.description: Max security deposit in months of rent

furnished.description: Set true only when the seeker explicitly asks for furnished. Omit for any furnishing.

has_ac.description: True only when AC is required. Omit or false means not required, not excluded.

has_lift.description: True only when a lift or elevator is required. Omit or false means not required, not excluded.

has_pets.description: True when the seeker has pets. Excludes homes that explicitly disallow pets. Unknown pet policy still appears as ask about pets.

locality.description: Exact area inside the city, such as Baner or Kharadi. A Baner search does not return Hinjewadi.

lock_in_max.description: Max lock-in months the seeker will accept

near_coworking.description: True only when near coworking is required. Omit or false means not required, not excluded.

near_transit.description: True only when near transit is required. Omit or false means not required, not excluded.

no_curfew.description: True when the seeker needs no gate curfew. Omit or false means not required, not excluded.

pet_friendly.description: True only when pets are required. Omit or false means not required, not excluded.

price_max.description: Max monthly rent in `currency` units. Defaults to the city's local currency (Pune INR, Dubai/Sharjah AED, Bangkok/Phuket THB, Vietnam VND). Example: 30000 INR, 4000 AED.

status.description: Household: Single, Couple, or Family (values single, partner, or family). single matches Everyone and Singles only. partner is Couple and matches Everyone and Couples. family matches Everyone and Families only.

stay_nights.description: Desired stay length in nights (7=1 week … 330=11 months, 365=12 months). 11 months is offered everywhere; it is the standard residential lease in India.
